description: Verifies the horizon regime analysis: constraint detection per metric, Kerr, Kerr-Newman and Nariai extremality classification, projection onto the sub-extremal domain, guaranteed parameter limits and zone layout geometry.

checks.label: Kerr constrains the spin only
Reissner-Nordstrom constrains the charge only
Kerr-Newman constrains spin and charge
Schwarzschild-de Sitter constrains the cosmological constant only
Schwarzschild has no horizon constraint
a / M = 0.5 is sub-extremal
the outer horizon equals M + sqrt(M^2 - a^2)
a / M = 1 is extremal
the extremal horizon sits at M
a / M = 1.1 is super-extremal
a super-extremal state reports the radius at M
a^2 + Q^2 = M^2 is extremal
a^2 + Q^2 > M^2 is super-extremal
projecting a super-extremal state reports a change
the projected state is sub-extremal
the projected extremality ratio respects the guarantee factor
Lambda M^2 = 1/18 is sub-extremal
Lambda M^2 = 1/9 is the Nariai limit
Lambda M^2 = 1/6 exceeds the Nariai limit
projecting a super-extremal cosmological state reports a change
the projected cosmological state is sub-extremal
the projected constant respects the guaranteed maximum
the guaranteed spin limit lies strictly between zero and the mass
constraining an excessive spin returns the guaranteed limit
a positive charge limit remains for a moderate spin
the combined spin and charge limit respects the guarantee factor
the spin axis has a symmetric layout
the spin threshold equals the mass
the mass axis is asymmetric with the sub-extremal zone above the threshold
the mass threshold equals the spin
